Package org.ujorm.orm.jdbc

Class ResultSetMapper<D>

java.lang.Object
org.ujorm.orm.jdbc.ResultSetMapper<D>
Type Parameters:
D - the root domain type
public final class ResultSetMapper<D> extends Object
Maps a database ResultSet to a hierarchical Bean structure using a pre-compiled mapping tree.

How Mapping Works

The mapper converts each row of a ResultSet into a domain object of type D. It uses column labels (which may contain dot notation, e.g., "address.city") to navigate, instantiate, and populate the hierarchical relation tree. To ensure high performance, it translates the flat column definitions into an internal MappingNode tree structure. This tree is cached and reused for subsequent result sets that share the exact same column layout.
